12.t: Working with data: finch beaks and drought
q: What was the mean beak depth in 1976?
By how much did it change after the drought?
In the drought only large hard seeds were left. Explain the change.
Finches with deeper beaks could crack hard seeds, so they survived and bred; their young inherited deep beaks.
Note the y-axis starts at 9 mm. Explain why this matters when you read the graph.
It makes a small change look large: 0.5 mm is about 5%, which is small but still important for survival.
